{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates on patient_id
# This ensures we keep the latest (highest sample_seq) test per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter out baseline biomarker values of -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values — divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL
df_clean.loc[df_clean['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 4: Check sites again
print(df_clean['site'].unique())"}
